Title: Two Simple questions on two cards.

Messages.Author: Chester DuBois
Messages.Body:
Hi Everyone.

Here are the two simple questions:

1. Dragon Breath Rounds says It adds +2 aggravated Damage. Does it mean I
inflict 1 normal damage and 2 aggravated or I inflict 3 aggravated damage?

2. I play a Fame on my prey, then I'm ousted. Is the Fame discarded?

Thanks everyone,
Luca "Chester DuBois" Ortolano.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chester DuBois wrote:
> Hi Everyone.
>
> Here are the two simple questions:
>
> 1. Dragon Breath Rounds says It adds +2 aggravated Damage. Does it mean I
> inflict 1 normal damage and 2 aggravated or I inflict 3 aggravated damage?

With a weapon that does 1R damage, DBR will cause the weapon to do 1 normal
plus 2 aggravated damage (ranged).

>
> 2. I play a Fame on my prey, then I'm ousted. Is the Fame discarded?

Yes.
